messages:
maria: Quick pass on routing editor UX: compact reorder shows a weird drag ghost that overlaps drop targets, and preview heatmap gets clipped on narrow panes. Can we triage?
charlie: Saw it. Ghost covers ~6px of the drop target in condensed lists. Likely transform offset or z-index. Screenshot posted. :eyes: 
anya: Repro. Happens with transform-based animation; placeholder height/anchor calc seems off.
kevin: Options: toggle pointer-events on ghost, or switch to absolute positioning during drag so hit-testing matches visual. Absolute is easier to reason about but might cause a slight reflow on start.
charlie: Visual ask: ghost opacity 0.7, dashed 1px placeholder outline showing exact drop anchor, and shrink the ghost slightly so it never fully covers the target.
maria: Also copy tweak for empty sim: current "No matching routes found" -> propose friendly: "No active routing rules match this input yet."
lydia: A11y: screenreader announces "dragging" but not the new position after drop. Need aria-live polite update, e.g. "Rule 'Chargeback' moved to position 2." Also keyboard reorder needs focusable placeholder and clear focus state.
anya: I'll add aria-live updates on reorder completion and ensure keyboard-handle focuses the placeholder. For ghost Ill try absolute top/left during drag so hitboxes align.
kevin: I'll re-anchor validation toasts to the rules panel to avoid overlapping the sim controls; also make the preview legend collapse under a chevron below 720px to prevent clipping.
charlie: Heatmap clipping root cause: preview canvas uses overflow:hidden at small widths. Suggest allow vertical scroll inside preview pane and move legend to collapsible area on narrow screens.
maria: Can we get small fixes (copy + toast anchor + ghost fix) in next sprint? Lydia will run SR tests once PRs land.
lydia: Yep, I'll run the screenreader sweep after merges and add failing cases to QA.
anya: Opening PR for ghost/keyboard changes today and will link here when ready.
kevin: I'll open PR for toast anchor and legend collapse.
ux-bot: Checklist: add unit test for drop-placeholder calc; add A11y checklist item for reordering; update design spec with dashed-placeholder mock. :white_check_mark: 
maria: Final copy to land: "No active routing rules match this input yet. Try relaxing filters or add a new rule." Please include with the copy PR.
charlie: Will update spec and attach the dashed placeholder mock and z-index note.
maria: Thanks team 680 - tagging for sprint planning.
